web.Register first to register, edit and man: Register first to manage Hugs. After verification, choose a package, then select *Register Hug* and follow the steps.

web.Photos attract the user's attention more: Photos attract the user's attention more than texts. Note that the hogs with appropriate and high-quality images have a higher attractiveness and visitation rate than the hogs without images. The number of photos allowed for each spore in each package is different. For example, it is allowed to send a maximum of 4 images in the free package, 8 images in the economic package and 12 images in the commercial package. Use real images from different angles and quality. The maximum size of the photo that can be uploaded is 22 MB and its dimensions should not be less than 600 x 600 pixels.
web.hugs without a photo will not be display: hugs without a photo will not be displayed in the first 5 positions under any circumstances.
web.To learn about the rules for choosing a: To learn about the rules for choosing a photo for Spore, visit the Spore Image Selection Guide.
web.Choose a place to publish Hug: Choose a place to publish Hug
web.The spore release location is a location: The spore release location is a location with a unique latitude and longitude, which is displayed with a cursor ( ) on the map. That place publishes. To publish a seed, it is necessary to register and add a publication location. Therefore, if you have not registered a publication location before, click on the + Register publication location option to register a location and register the first publication location of your user account. In all packages, the spore spreader can register a maximum of 20 spore spreading locations, but the number of locations that the user is allowed to choose for each spore is limited and is not the same for all packages.
web.Click on the box for selecting a publica: Click on the box for selecting a publication location and select your publication location or locations from the list of locations that you have registered. You can delete any of the selected places or choose another place.
web.To learn how to create a release locatio: To learn how to create a release location, refer to the guide for registering the release location of hugs.
web.After selecting the release locations, s: After selecting the release locations, select your spore release radius using the graduated rod. Your spore will spread from the center of these locations to the radius you chose. The spore acceptors that are in the range of this diffusion radius will receive your spore.
web.The spore transmitter attaches its spore: The spore transmitter attaches its spore to Wi-Fi and broadcasts it to the spore receivers within the Wi-Fi coverage area. Each Wi-Fi, depending on the strength of its waves, covers a range around it.
web.Choose the name of your Wi-Fi or Wi-Fies: Choose the name of your Wi-Fi or Wi-Fies from the list of Wi-Fies you have registered and spread your spore around these Wi-Fies. In all packages, the spore spreader can register a maximum of 10 Wi-Fies for spore propagation, but the number of Wi-Fies that the user is allowed to choose for each spore is limited and is not the same for all packages. Click on the box related to Select a broadcast Wi-Fi and select your broadcast Wi-Fi or Wi-Fies from the list of Wi-Fies you have registered. You can select multiple Wi-Fi broadcasts for each hotspot. You can also delete any selected Wi-Fi or choose another Wi-Fi. Unlike the release location, choosing a release Wi-Fi is not mandatory for a spore.
web.To learn about the Wi-Fi registration me: To learn about the Wi-Fi registration method, refer to the Wi-Fi registration guide for spore distribution.
web.Choosing the start and end time of publi: Choosing the start and end time of publishing Hug
web.Many services and businesses need to dis: Many services and businesses need to display their message to their target audience in a specific time frame to provide service to their customers. By selecting the start and end time of your spore release, you can publish it within a defined time interval.
web.Note that the spore spreader can spread: Note that the spore spreader can distribute a spore from one or all registered Wi-Fi locations with the same start/end time and spread radius. To spread a spore from different locations with varying radii and times, select the 'Add New Form' option.
web.Click on the box corresponding to the st: Click on the start and end time boxes, then select the dates/times from the calendar. You can edit this range anytime.
web.The last step: ways of communication - p: Final Step: Communication Methods - Preview and Register Hug
web.It is necessary to select the area of Ha: You must select Hag's area. Choose your province, city, and district from the list. The red pin shows the approximate location on the map. (For other countries, enter the address in the designated box.)
web.To select the exact location of your spo: To pinpoint your spore's location, zoom/scroll the map, then click or drag the cursor ( ) to the desired spot.
web.The mobile number that was confirmed dur: Your verified mobile number is your account's unique ID and is displayed by default. Users will contact you via this number.
web.It is not allowed to include the contact: Including contact numbers in spore descriptions is prohibited. Any numbers will be masked with asterisks (*****) after publication.
web.Activate Hog chat by selecting Hog's opt: Enable Hog Chat to allow communication via online chat alongside calls/SMS. In some categories, hiding your number restricts contact to Hog Chat only.
web.If you have entered your email when comp: Your account email is displayed by default on the add page. You can change it on the contact page for user communications.
web.Email registration is possible in some p: Email registration is available in some packages. Including emails in descriptions is prohibited and will be masked (*****).
web.First, select the type of social network: Select the social network type (website, Instagram, etc.) and enter its URL. Available in select packages with varying limits. Use '+Add Social Network' for more.

web.Use real images from different angles an: Use real images from different angles and of good quality, related to the topic of hugs. The maximum upload size for photos is 22 MB, and dimensions should not be less than 600 x 600 pixels. The number of photos allowed per spore varies by package.
web.An image that contains any of the follow: Images containing any of the following will not be approved or published:
web.The image has a colored frame: The image has a colored border
web.The image is small or of inappropriate q: The image is too small or of poor quality

web.The image is not real and is made with 3: The image is not real and is created using 3D design software.

web.You will see the list of your hugs on th: You can view your hugs list on the hugs page and in the dashboard's hugs section. Each spore entry shows the title, category, downloads/visits, last update date, type (special/gold), status (active/stopped/under review), and edit/delete options.
web.Spore status can be Active, Stopped, Exp: Spore statuses: Active, Stopped, Expired, Under Review, Needs Editing, Renew, or Rejected.

web.When the spore is reviewed and approved,: Once approved, hugs are published in the app for adopters and marked as 'Active' in the dashboard.
web.If for any reason you find it necessary: You can pause spore publication temporarily. When the publication period ends, it stops automatically (marked 'Stopped'). Reactivate or extend the period to republish.
web.After you have registered your spore, th: After registration, hugs enter review queue for approval. Review may take up to [max] working hours. If approved, they're activated and published.
web.When the validity date of your package e: When your package expires, all hugs expire and stop publishing, showing 'Expired' status.
web.After you select and activate a new pack: Activating a new package changes expired hugs to 'Renew' status. Edit and republish expired hugs or register new ones.
